description: This source file defines the ConfigurationResolver class in the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides methods for resolving AWS configuration settings from environment variables, configuration files, and default values.

classes.name: Aws\Configuration\ConfigurationResolver
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve AWS SDK configuration from environment variables, ini files, and defaults.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a configuration value by checking environment variables, shared config files, and defaults.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Retrieves and converts an environment variable corresponding to a configuration key.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Reads and retrieves a configuration value from an ini file, supporting sections and subsections.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Returns home directory path based on environment variables for Unix and Windows.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Determines the default configuration file path, considering environment variables.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts string values to the expected data type (bool, int).

methods.name: retrieveValueFromIniSubsection
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from an ini subsection, supporting more complex config structures.
